title: Starter HTML and CSS
description: CAT 100 textbook section on starter HTML and CSS, centered on an accessibility revision pass, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Construct a minimal valid HTML document, placing metadata (title, charset, stylesheet link) in <head> and visible content in <body>.
Write descriptive alt text for informative images and justify empty alt for decorative ones against WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1.
Predict which CSS rule wins when selectors conflict, using specificity first and source order as the tiebreaker.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
